criteria_results.text: Answering an agent 'ask question' (AskUserQuestion) card resumes the agent instead of hanging at 'Waiting for question…'.
criteria_results.notes: Manual smoke PASS: user clicked an option, the 'Answered: Test passed' stub appeared, and the agent continued ('Test passed. The ask question feature is working.'). No formal contract file because this was a bug, not an issue-writer ticket — acceptance-contract legitimately skipped (no acceptance-criteria section). Regression covered by new tests: opc_question_handshake.test.ts (5) + question_reply_handshake_test.dart (2).

criteria_results.text: The question card renders correctly in dark mode.
criteria_results.notes: Manual smoke caught a VISUAL defect the automated gate had explicitly flagged as unverifiable (verification-gate Required-Evidence #8: the card only appears mid-agent-session and could not be screenshot-driven). The card (pre-existing #622 code, plus the rows added in this fix) was hardcoded to light-theme colors, so it rendered as a white card in dark mode. Fixed in-session by converting every hardcoded color to context.rhythm theme tokens (commit db97f8b); re-smoked PASS in dark mode. This is the gate working as designed — it disclosed the visual gap, manual smoke covered it. Not a divergence in the verified behavior (the reply handshake).

process_issues.description: issue_638_contract_test.dart (test/features/agents/) flakily failed Desktop CI with 'This test failed after it had already completed' — AgentsController.initialize() → loadInspectorPrefs() → SharedPreferences.getInstance() rejects asynchronously after the test body completes when the shared_preferences mock channel is not registered. Passed locally by timing; failed once on CI; passed on rerun.
process_issues.detected_by: Desktop CI first run failed (gh run view --log-failed); stack trace pointed at SharedPreferences.getInstance after test completion. Confirmed unrelated to the question fix (no changed files in the path). Remediated by a parallel de-flake commit (4b66c3f) registering SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({}) in setUp.

process_issues.description: verification-gate ran the FULL server vitest (1078/1078) but scoped the Flutter run to test/features/agents/ rather than the full `flutter test` that Desktop CI runs. The P4 flake lives in that directory and passed locally by timing, so a full local run would not have reliably caught it either — but the scope gap is worth noting.
process_issues.detected_by: Comparing the verification-gate command set (flutter test test/features/agents/) against the Desktop CI step (full flutter test).

issues.description: TodoWrite was attempted at the start but the tool was not enabled in this session context ('No such tool available: TodoWrite'); phases were tracked inline instead. Tooling limitation, not a discipline skip.
issues.detected_by: Transcript: TodoWrite call returned an error, followed by an explicit note to track phases inline.

suggested_follow_up: When a UI change is only observable mid-agent-session (so verification-gate cannot screenshot it), the smoke handoff should explicitly call out 'verify in BOTH light and dark mode' so theming defects are caught on the first smoke rather than a second round.
